column1: # One-line summaries of prereg/DEVIATIONS.md for Supplementary Table (src/make_si_tables.py). One line per log entry, in order.
# Fields, tab-separated: entry hash (from make_si_tables.py --hashes), timing, change, scores seen. LaTeX; name no hub model.
# Timing restates the entry's own words; it adds nothing the entry does not say.

column2: Before the freeze
column3: Pipeline dry run on pilot models wrote feature files before the freeze; only success or failure lines and timings were read.

column2: After the freeze, before confirmatory training
column3: Training precision fixed: parameters kept in float32 with bf16 autocast and saved in float32, since bf16 parameters rounded away small updates. Earlier pilot models superseded. No rule, threshold or hypothesis changed.

column2: After the freeze, before any hub model was downloaded or scored
column3: Hub siblings are a seeded random sample of up to 800 usable derivatives per family, at most 3 per publisher, instead of all usable derivatives, to bound download size. Chosen from metadata only.

column2: After the freeze, before any confirmatory score
column3: Feature extraction loads float32 instead of bf16, and adapters load against the pinned base revision. Measured on the pilot family only.

column2: After the freeze, before any copy was trained
column3: Details of copies left open by the preregistration fixed: data for further tuning and students, choice of merge partners, simulated quantization and pruning, and student training settings.

column2: After the freeze, before any hub model was downloaded or scored
column3: Stratum coding details fixed: identical cards coded once, cards cut to 3{,}000 characters plus later data lines, overlap coded per claimant dataset, two passes by the same language model on differently ordered batches.

column2: Before any hub model was downloaded or scored
column3: Stratum coding departed from its instructions: some runs read cards cut at 1{,}300 to 2{,}200 characters, and early batches allowed evidence stitched from separate phrases. Effect audited; codes not edited, and agreement met the recoding rule. Named-dataset hub strata fall under the floor for rejection and are reported as unable to reject.

column2: Authors' decision, before any hub model was downloaded or scored
column3: Hub siblings restricted to Apache-2.0, MIT or untagged licences (61 sampled models excluded on metadata). Llama and Gemma derivatives excluded from controls. Two pilot-family control bases replaced, giving the 10 control bases listed in Methods.

column2: Before any hub model was downloaded or scored
column3: Weight check defined: at least 90\% of the base's parameter names with matching shapes, cosine to the base above 0.5, and not bit-identical to the base. Uses the base only, never a claimant.

column2: After the freeze, before any confirmatory copy
column3: Quantization of copies changed from per-tensor min-max, which destroyed 4-bit copies in the pilot, to simulated 8-bit per-row and 4-bit NF4 formats on linear layers.
column4: Pilot claimant-copy agreement; no sibling comparison

column2: Before any confirmatory score
column3: Timestamp proofs upgraded to Bitcoin attestations, earliest block 974838; entries dated later are not covered by that hash.

column2: After the freeze, before any confirmatory score
column3: Audited methods aligned with their source papers: REEF layer, dataset and threshold; Witness Overlap rule and training family; LLMPrint settings and chat template. All labelled as reimplementations.
column4: Pilot models for testing only; no sibling comparison

column2: After the freeze, before any confirmatory score
column3: Analysis code written and tested on synthetic data. Three readings of the preregistration fixed: S2 holds out recipe cells, S3 runs within the low stratum, and H4(b) uses the 20-step and both quantized copies.

column2: Before any confirmatory score
column3: Adapter loading fixed (resized embeddings, nonstandard key prefixes) and the weight check rerun with the rule unchanged: hub siblings passing rose from 1{,}256 to 1{,}296 of 1{,}539. Remaining failures inspected and none is a loader fault.
column4: None; causes read from error text

column2: Before any LLMPrint score existed
column3: LLMPrint kept at the paper's full settings; its search runs under bf16 autocast to cut cost, with bits always read in float32. No method cut for cost.
column4: Claimant search loss only; no suspect scored

column2: Before any confirmatory score
column3: Application of each method's original rule specified, including pools P1 and P2, the REEF and LLMPrint thresholds, Holm correction across method and family, and one keyed variant per claimant. Keyed copies not built, so keyed power is not measured.

column2: Before any LLMPrint score existed, with no confirmatory score inspected
column3: From full-text reading of the sources: LLMPrint accepts at agreement at or above the threshold. Departures kept and disclosed for Nikoli\'c (test form, prompt count, controls), MPS (p-value, prompt count), Thakur and Khoury (no trace gate), LLMPrint (validation models) and REEF (sample count).

column2: Before any confirmatory score, with no feature value read
column3: Replacement rule for independent controls that could not be loaded: each base takes its first 11 usable models in the frozen seeded order, from 6 fixed reserves per base. Usable means features were written.
column4: None; success or failure status only

column2: Before any confirmatory score, with no feature value read
column3: Exploratory ablations specified (reference size, contamination, label noise, score-based removal), and power reported against graded transformation levels; weight-space and behaviour-space distances dropped.

column2: Before any confirmatory score, with no feature value read
column3: Tokenizer loading: four TinyLlama hub siblings with SentencePiece-only tokenizers re-extracted after packages were added; one Qwen3 hub sibling needing custom tokenizer code excluded.
column4: None; causes read from error text

column2: After TinyLlama scoring ran, with no suspect score read
column3: A chat template that raises on a standard message is treated as absent, and the model gets the plain prompt; one TinyLlama hub sibling rescored. Other prompts unchanged.
column4: None; file format on claimant rows only

column2: After TinyLlama scoring, before any analysis, with no suspect score read
column3: Keyed scoring drops token-type inputs before generation; one TinyLlama hub sibling rescored. Correction to the previous entry's count of failures.

column2: After the confirmatory analysis; post hoc
column3: Fidelity check of the reimplementations against their source texts and reported results, with no model run. MPS and REEF behave as their papers report on declared copies. LLMPrint follows the paper's text but does not reproduce its reported detection performance, and is labelled so. No rule, threshold or verdict changed.

column2: After the confirmatory analysis; wording only
column3: The keyed fingerprint is described as a simple instance of instructional fingerprinting rather than a new method, after reading Chain \& Hash and Nasery et al. One figure label changed; no value changed.

column2: After the confirmatory analysis; post hoc and exploratory
column3: Further analyses of existing scores: score distributions by recipe and adapter type, two grouped hub splits (upload quarter, adapter type), the composition of the reference-size ablation, tied scores, and a metadata comparison of hub models that failed the weight check. No rule, threshold or verdict changed.

column2: After the confirmatory analysis; post hoc and exploratory
column3: Two additions: keyed copies through the frozen copy grid (390 copies) to measure the keyed fingerprint's power on copies, and one human coder coding a stratified sample of 150 hub model cards to measure human-LLM agreement. The LLM codes remain the codes used in every analysis. No rule, threshold or verdict changed.
column4: Keyed copies (new); hub stratum codes (check only)
